title: studied-subject
description: The codomain of studying: a subject after its claim-lattice has been settled. consensus = knowledge-order meet of observers; truth = the resolved FOUR value (top if still contradictory after the budget); confidence = |mean truth-lean|; dissent = a STUB dispersion measure (the real measure is the deferred sheaf Laplacian / H^1, not this); accepted = confidence within threshold. Only an accepted studied-subject is fit to project into a spacesuit as memory.
